title: The best habit tracker out there
body:
After having tried out multiple habit trackers before, I discovered this one through a YT video and man am I glad that I found this beautiful app. 

The UX is super simple and well designed. The UI keeps the core things at the forefront while keeping everything else hidden. The biggest thing - the joy of seeing your “habit commits” grow and grow with every passing day. 

It doesn’t guilt you for missing out on things either. You just start over again and it’s all good.  Great app for anyone who struggles with starting and maintaining their habits

title: Best habit tracker ever!
body:
I’ve tried a bunch of habit trackers (both free & paid). While most of them were decent, this one is a LITERAL HIDDEN GEM! 

The best part of Habitkit:
1. Colour coded grid view (single best feature of this app)
2. Simplicity to the max 
3. Unlimited trackable habits (pro only tho) 
4. Monthly trend view 
5. Total completions, Best & current streak 
6. Super clear icons 
7. Tags to group habits under unique groups 
8. Timely reminders for each habit (life saver!)
9. Data export/import 

Overall, this app has helped me increase my productivity, thanks to the motivation i get looking at the monthly grid view & analytic data.

title: Fits my needs exactly !
body:
've been using this habit tracker app for a while now, and I must say it’s fantastic! The user interface is clean and intuitive, making it easy to track and manage my daily habits. One feature that stands out is the ability to set multiple completions per day. This is incredibly useful for tasks that require incremental progress, like studying for a few hours or drinking multiple glasses of water.

I initially overlooked this feature, but after some exploration, I found that you can customize the completions per day and track your progress in a visually appealing way. The app uses a shading system similar to GitHub's contributions graph, where the intensity of the color increases with the number of completions. This visual feedback is motivating and helps me stay on track.

Overall, the app is well-designed, feature-rich, and highly customizable. It's perfect for anyone looking to build and maintain new habits. Highly recommended!
